feeds.title: Jessica Moorhouse Blog
feeds.description: Hello! I'm Jessica and I'm a millennial personal finance expert, award-winning blogger, host of the Mo' Money Podcast, founder of the Millennial Money Meetup and co-founder of Rich & Fit..I Blog about saving, budgeting & investing Money. When I started this blog 5 years ago, I just wanted it to be a way for me to track my personal finance journey and keep myself accountable. Follow my blog as I share tips on saving, budgeting & investing.

feeds.title: Gen Y Planning Blog
feeds.description: I'm Sophia Bera a Fee-Only CFP® who provides affordable financial planning to clients in their 20s and 30s. I help people navigate through big life decisions, like buying a home, paying off student loans, maximizing their company benefits, planning their next vacation, investing in their future, and resisting their brother-in-law's hot stock tip.

feeds.title: Millennial Revolution
feeds.description: Welcome to the Millennial Revolution, a FIRE (Financial Independence Retire Early) site started by two computer engineers/children's authors, FIRECracker & Wanderer, who retired at 31 to travel the world!

feeds.title: My Millennial Guide
feeds.description: My Millennial Guide is a finance-focused online publishing platform empowering others to take part in better financial literacy. Learn the best ways to save money, make more money, and get career advice by joining the Millennial community.

feeds.title: Urban 20 Something Blog
feeds.description: I'm Leah. Welcome to Urban 20 Something and I'm here to help you make money outside of your 9-5 job and build wealth at a young age, and are becoming financially secure and ahead.

feeds.title: Young Finances
feeds.description: LaTisha 'Tish' Styles is a nationally recognised millennial personal finance expert, author, and TV personality. LaTisha helps corporations, investment advisers, and financial service firms reach a millennial audience leveraging blogs, social media, and video content to build a buzz.

feeds.title: Make Money Your Honey Blog
feeds.description: Hey there! I'm a millennial business coach who teaches online entrepreneurs how to make money their honey with online marketing. My mission is to provide the millennial generation with practical, simple, and effective resources for personal development, business growth and personal finance.

feeds.title: Millennial Boss Blog
feeds.description: Welcome! Millennial Boss is for all the bosses out there killing it in their businesses, paying off debt, and building wealth.

feeds.title: Making a Millennial Millionaire
feeds.description: Articles and strategies related to earning, saving and investing to a million dollar. Also dives into publicly traded companies, giving you insight into their businesses and founders to see if it could be a good investment in the long-run.

feeds.title: The Millennial Money Woman Blog
feeds.description: Features latest financial tips, wealth-building strategies, investing guides, and millionaire planning. The Millennial Money Woman is a personal finance platform empowering millennials to achieve their financial goals and gain financial freedom.

feeds.title: Fiery Millennials Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to my blog! If you are a millennial who hates the rat race, this is the place to be!I started this to document my journey to Financial Independence. My goal is to help guide my fellow millennials along similar paths to financial freedom.

feeds.title: Broke Millennial Blog
feeds.description: Hey! I'm Erin. I help millennials like you get your financial life together through this blog, my book, lectures, and workshops. I'm here to give you practical advice so you can navigate the pesky but important money questions on your mind.

feeds.title: Poorer Than You
feeds.description: Stephanie has been sharing her personal finances, observations, and real talk about money on Poorer Than You for 10 years now. Poorer Than You is a personal finance blog for college students and mainly focusing on Millennials or Generation Y. This site offers no 'get rich quick' schemes, but the goal here is to put you in a better financial position.

feeds.title: Teen Learner
feeds.description: Covers personal finance articles for teens & students, from getting a job to starting an online business. Teen Learner was created with the goal of helping teenagers learn the financial basics for a successful future.

feeds.title: Bay Street Blog
feeds.description: Bay Street Blog is a platform for Millennial Finance with a focus on Personal Finance, and Self Directed Investing topics. With a team of Contributing Authors from different Canadian Universities, our goal is to improve your financial literacy.

feeds.title: Money-Smart Millennials Blog
feeds.description: Money-Smart Millennials comes to fill a need for the millennial generation. The tips and mindset exposed in the book are not those of a Certified Public Accountant (CPA), a financial planner or financial adviser. They are simply based on the experiences of a millennial who has achieved financial stability and has helped others to do the same.

feeds.title: young savers Blog
feeds.description: The #1 personal finance blog for young people

feeds.title: Launch Your Finances - Conor Richardson
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Conor Richardson. I write about Personal Finance for Millennials: paying off debt, saving cash and designing your financial freedom. Thousands of people read my material to learn how to pay off debt, save more and find the financial freedom to design their life. This means eliminating credit card debt, paying off student loans, saving serious cash, funding your retirement etc.

feeds.title: Drunken Money - Finance for Millennials by Millennials Blog
feeds.description: Hi, We are Paul and John, two financial professionals and Drunken Money is our brainchild. We were tired of hearing millennials being stereotyped and talked down to by older generations regarding their finances. We wanted a place where millennials could help each other, and everyone could learn some cool stuff in the process.

feeds.title: Stock Street Blog
feeds.description: Learning how to invest can be confusing, but it doesn't have to be. Stock Street helps beginner millennial investors navigate the crazy investment world. Whether you want to learn how to invest in the stock market through individual stocks or index funds, Stock Street can help you get there! You will find articles about different topics for beginner millennial investors.

feeds.title: Bone Fide Wealth Blog
feeds.description: Financial Advice for Millennials, Young Professionals, and Entrepreneurs. Get the latest news on our blog for wealth management and investments.

feeds.title: Millennial Money Probs
feeds.description: Millennial Money Probs is a millennial money blog by Maggie Kroll.

feeds.title: Mr Investor
feeds.description: Mr Investor's author is a millennial who is passionate about investing and this blog is a collection of his thoughts on investment and trading. The articles that he share are about companies that he come across, the articles do not tantamount to a buy or sell recommendation.

feeds.title: Whitney Hansen Blog
feeds.description: Hi I am Whitney. I teach millennials how to pay off debt and gain financial independence. I give them the tools to have more fun with money. Real money advice for millennials.

feeds.title: Millennial Money Man
feeds.description: Welcome to Millennial Money Man. This site is a personal finance resource for young people that covers debt-freedom, making more money, and building wealth.

feeds.title: Millennial Money Diaries
feeds.description: Hey there! My name is Jing, and welcome to the Millennial Money Diaries. This blog is meant to be a place to share my daily spending, monthly budgets, tips, and random personal finance tidbits.
